metadata.name: ManualCharge-off
metadata.description: This API is used to Apply Manual Charge Off.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Currency Code Ex. 840 = US Doller. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language ==  en: means use English ---- es: means Spanish Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account Number of the account to be charged off. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 8000000000000037 Condition: At least one account identifier is required from: 1. AccountNumber 2. AdminNumber 3. AccountID Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Admin number of the account to be charged off. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 12345 Condition: At least one account identifier is required from: 1. AccountNumber 2. AdminNumber 3. AccountID

request_fields.name: AccountID
request_fields.description: Account ID represents Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entitity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition: At least one account identifier is required from: 1. AccountNumber 2. AdminNumber 3. AccountID

request_fields.name: UserChargeOffStatus
request_fields.description: Status that user wants to set for mentioned account. Valid Values: 0-4 0 - Not Charged-off 1 - Pending Manual Initial Charge-off 2 - Hold Initial Charge-off 3 - Started Initial Charge-off 4 - Started Final Charge-off Format: X Example: 1 Condition: Either 1 of UserChargeOffStatus Or AutoInitialChargeOff is required.

request_fields.name: InitialManualChargeOffReason
request_fields.description: Reason to initiate manual charge-off Valid Values: 0-7 0 - None 1 - Credit Losses 2 - Bankruptcy 3 - Fraud 4 - Other 6 - Deceased 7 - Contractional Format: X Example: 3 Condition: Mandatory if UserChargeOffStatus has a valid value

request_fields.name: FinalStatement
request_fields.description: If final statement is needed or not Valid Values: 0, 1 0 - No 1 - Yes Format: X Example: 1 Condition: Default 1

request_fields.name: ManualInitialChargeOffStartDate
request_fields.description: Start Date of Manual Initial Charge-Off Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 05/01/2020

request_fields.name: TimingOption
request_fields.description: Option to initiate charge-off Valid Values: 0, 1, 2 0 - Default 1 - Charge-off Date 2 - Last Payment Date Format: X Example: 0 Condition: Pass value 0 by default

request_fields.name: AutoInitialChargeOff
request_fields.description: Value of delinquency to be overriden wrt configured value. Valid Values: 0, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 0 - None 3 - 1 Cycle Past Due 4 - 2 Cycle Past Due 5 - 3 Cycle Past Due 6 - 4 Cycle Past Due 7 - 5 Cycle Past Due 8 - 6 Cycle Past Due Format: X Example: 3
